title: Performance requirements and methods of test of TV ferrite components, Part 3: Core for deflection coil
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 3 ) covers performance requirements of core for deflection coil.
clause_3_terminology: Performance requirements and methods of test of TV ferrite components

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
